why: Visual A over a multibyte character: Neovim writes a split character (src/keys/README, Neovim's own)
CTRL-V on a Tab then ~ u U over a 2-byte character: Neovim moves the character to the end of the line (src/keys/README, Neovim's own)
s on a Tab that ends its line, then Tab: Neovim's w_virtcol stays the Tab's last cell (src/keys/README, package 5)
I Down from a blank a combining mark is on, after k (src/keys/README, package 5)
Visual gUU is gU then U, and U (undo line) is not in FEATURES.md, so not built (src/keys/README)
block > over blanks that end in a combining mark: Neovim drops the mark (src/keys/README, Neovim's own)
an operator with v over a sentence that ends the buffer in a multibyte character: Neovim ends inside the character (src/keys/README, Neovim's own)
block $ I with CTRL-W over a ZWJ emoji after r: Neovim writes split characters and ours others (src/keys/README, not traced, package 5)
after A, Esc, v 3B y and a linewise yank, Neovim's curswant is 5 cells, ours 0, so the next >{ or j lands elsewhere (src/keys/README, not traced, package 5)
block I, then Left before the block's start and text: Neovim repeats a character of the line instead of the text (src/keys/README, Neovim's own)
a counted insert, Left, then Tab: Neovim's softtabstop counts from a stale cached w_virtcol, as for s Tab (src/keys/README, not traced, package 5)
Up, Down, CTRL-O or Del at a cursor inside a cluster that typing made with a lone combining mark: core_vcol gives the cluster's end, Neovim's getvcol its start (src/keys/README, package 4)
CTRL-W Tab (CTRL-W CTRL-I, split and jump to a keyword's definition) needs search and windows: not built (src/keys/README)
R after r, then CTRL-U back over the r: Neovim's replace stack still holds the character r replaced and puts it back (src/keys/README, Neovim's own)
block C, then Down and more text: the cursor after Esc differs by one (src/keys/README, not traced, package 5)
Visual A over a multibyte character typed earlier: Neovim writes a split character (src/keys/README, Neovim's own; the rule above needs it in the text)
gg, then C-v < on a line that is only a Tab: Neovim shifts it to 4 spaces, ours to 7; without gg Neovim gives 7 too (src/keys/README, not traced, package 5)
gv after a counted C over several lines that held the Visual marks: Neovim's '< ends on the joined line, ours a line lower (src/keys/README, not traced, package 4's mark moves)
CTRL-V U past U+10FFFF: Neovim writes bytes that are not UTF-8 (or a special-key code from 0x80000000), ours inserts nothing (src/keys/README)
